      1. Evidence   stack  overview                                                 
                                                                                    
                                                                                    
      The full stack now has three evidentiary registers. The first is prevention: Arda records where the system boundary
      denies or prevents behavior at the lowest level. The second is telemetry and response: Metatron/Seraph monitors
      produce threat records, MITRE technique links, and remediation actions. The third is agentic benchmarking: AAB
      tests live LLM adversarial profiles under controls, repeats and mutations.
